title: Weygandt's sergeant responds to UAPGerb's email using his full name

tellings.quote: but one of them, um, I emailed from my uapgrmail.com email.

plain: An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb says he emailed a sergeant linked to a man named Weygandt from his pseudonymous "uapgerb" email account, and the sergeant wrote back using UAPGerb's real full name. UAPGerb tells this from his own experience, naming a Sergeant Atkins and a Sergeant Allen, and it suggests someone on the other end already knew who he was.
